The fix distinguishes None from byte values during newline construction: None receives a text newline, while bytes and bytearray receive b'\n' and continue through the binary writer path.

root_cause.summary: click.echo converted an empty bytes or bytearray message into a text newline when nl=True. For a binary custom stream, this reached file.write as str and raised TypeError.
